acceptance_criteria.statement: The specified artifacts implement or precisely disposition the linked requirements and preserve stable architecture, source, ADR, and work-item traceability.
Applicable behavior tests and evidence pass, and unavailable live or external verification remains explicitly represented.

definition_of_done: Applicable implementation is complete or accurately dispositioned.
Acceptance criteria have current verification evidence.
Required tests pass for affected behavior.
Traceability, ADRs, plans, Jira, and documentation are updated.
Security, provenance, observability, and rollback effects are addressed.
No unresolved blocker or external verification gap is hidden by status.
description: Complete the architecture decision and technology-selection set.
exclusions: No unverified claim of live external-system completion.
No external write or source incorporation is authorized by this item.
objective: Complete the architecture decision and technology-selection set
observability_impact: Record structured state, correlation, validation, and evidence with stable identifiers.
rationale: This bounded work converts accepted architecture or upstream requirements into explicit implementation, verification, provenance, and operational state.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve prior valid artifacts and provide deterministic regeneration, adapter replacement, or rollback.
scope: Complete the architecture decision and technology-selection set
security_impact: Enforce authority, secret, dependency, data-egress, provenance, and external-mutation boundaries.
title: Complete the architecture decision and technology-selection set
